The old French grain was 1/9216 livre or 53.11 milligrams, and in the mesures usuelles permitted from 1812 to 1839, with the livre redefined as 500 grams, it was 54.25 milligrams.
A former unit of gold purity, also known as carat grain, equal to 1/4 "carat" (karat).

To yield fruit.
A branch of a tree; a stalk or stem of a plant.
A tine, prong, or fork.

definitions.definitionEn: Situated.

definitions.definitionEn: A quick breaking or cracking sound or the action of producing such a sound.
A sudden break.
An attempt to seize, bite, attack, or grab.
The act of making a snapping sound by pressing the thumb and an opposing finger of the same hand together and suddenly releasing the grip so that the finger hits against the palm.
A fastening device that makes a snapping sound when used.
A photograph; a snapshot.

example.en: We took a few snaps of the old church before moving on.
example.ja: 私たちは、移動する前に、古い教会を数スリップしました。

definitions.definitionEn: The sudden release of something held under pressure or tension.

example.en: a ginger snap
example.ja: ジンジャーシュート

definitions.definitionEn: A brief, sudden period of a certain weather; used primarily in the phrase cold snap.
A very short period of time (figuratively, the time taken to snap one's fingers), or a task that can be accomplished in such a period.

example.en: I can fix most vacuum cleaners in a snap.
example.ja: ほとんどの掃除機を修理できる

definitions.definitionEn: A snap bean such as Phaseolus vulgaris.
A backward pass or handoff of a football from its position on the ground that puts the ball in play; a hike.
(somewhat colloquial) A rivet: a scrapbooking embellishment.
A small meal, a snack; lunch.
A card game, primarily for children, in which players cry "snap" to claim pairs of matching cards as they are turned up.
A greedy fellow.
That which is, or may be, snapped up; something bitten off, seized, or obtained by a single quick movement; hence, a bite, morsel, or fragment; a scrap.
Briskness; vigour; energy; decision
Any circumstance out of which money may be made or an advantage gained. used primarily in the phrase soft snap.
Something that is easy or effortless.
A snapper, or snap beetle.
Jounce (the fourth derivative of the position vector with respect to time), followed by crackle and pop
A quick offhand shot with a firearm; a snap shot.
Something of no value.

example.en: not worth a snap
example.ja: スナップに値しない

definitions.definitionEn: A visual message sent through the Snapchat application.
A crisp or pithy quality; epigrammatic point or force.

An easy and profitable place or task; a sinecure.

definitions.definitionEn: To give forth or produce a sharp cracking noise; to crack.

example.ja: 焚き火の散り方。

definitions.definitionEn: To attempt to seize with the teeth or bite.

example.en: A dog snaps at a passenger. A fish snaps at the bait.

example.ja: 彼女はテレビに出演する機会を絶った。

example.ja: 彼は少しの間違いで私を裏切った。

definitions.definitionEn: To flash or appear to flash as with light.

example.ja: 浮動ツールバーは、その方向にドラッグするとスクリーンの端にスナップします。

definitions.definitionEn: To snatch with or as if with the teeth.

example.ja: 接着剤を鳴らす

definitions.definitionEn: To close something using a snap as a fastener.

To take a photograph; to release a camera's shutter (which may make a snapping sound).

example.ja: 彼は口を開いて私の写真を切り裂いて、眼をつぶった。

example.ja: 政治的な大会での決議や決定

definitions.definitionEn: The cry used in a game of snap when winning a hand.

example.ja: 2人ともピンクのバケツとスパデスを持ってる

definitions.definitionEn: Ritual utterance of agreement (after the cry in the card game snap).

example.en: "I just ran over your phone with my car." "Oh, snap!"
example.ja: "車であなたの携帯を走ってきたの" "ああ、スナップ!

definitions.definitionEn: Ritual utterance used after something is said by two people at exactly the same time.

example.en: "Wasn't that John?" "Wasn't that John?" "Snap!"

definitions.definitionEn: Come along with me; join me in going.

example.en: I'll show you where the auditorium is. Come on!
example.ja: 講堂がどこにあるか見せようさあ!

definitions.definitionEn: An expression of encouragement.

example.en: Come on, George! You can win!
example.ja: さあジョージ勝てるわよ!

definitions.definitionEn: An expression of disbelief.

example.en: Come on! You can't possibly expect me to believe that.
example.ja: 信じられないだろ?

definitions.definitionEn: An expression of frustration, exasperation, or impatience; hurry up.

example.en: Aw, come on! Get on with it!
example.ja: さあ早く行け!

definitions.definitionEn: An expression of defiance or as a challenge; approach; come at me.

example.en: Come on! I'm not afraid of you.
example.ja: 恐くないよ

definitions.definitionEn: Something intended to attract, as in an advertisement.

example.en: The free offers are just come-ons to get you in the store so the sales staff can work on you.
example.ja: 無料のオファーは、店に迎えにくる。セールスマンが働くように。

definitions.definitionEn: A statement or sometimes action reflecting sexual or romantic interest.

example.en: I thought he'd asked me to lunch to discuss business; I wasn't expecting a come-on.
example.ja: ランチを頼んでたと思ってたわ

definitions.definitionEn: A bad actor whose talents do not extend far beyond walking onto the stage.

meaning: （意味を準備中）
人の家や他所を訪ねる

definitions.definitionEn: to visit someone's home or other location.

meaning: エネルギーを注ぐと

definitions.definitionEn: To approach with a lot of energy
To be very eager, to want something (too) much, especially a romantic or sexual partner

meaning: ロマンチックあるいは性的な面で前進するために

definitions.definitionEn: To make a romantic or sexual advance to; to hit on.

example.en: He was really coming on to me at the party.
example.ja: 彼は本当にパーティーで私に向かって来た。

definitions.definitionEn: To start to.

example.en: It came on to snow after dusk.
example.ja: 夕暮れから雪が降った。

meaning: サービスに入るかアクティブになる

definitions.definitionEn: To enter service or become active.

example.en: It will be some time before the new factory comes online, and until then we can't fulfill demand.
example.ja: 新しい工場がオンラインになるにはしばらくかかるが、それまでは需要を満たせない。

definitions.definitionEn: To log in to an Internet communication system, such as an instant messenger, online game or forum.

example.en: Come online later; I want to talk to you.
example.ja: (2018年3月18日). http://www.nikkansports.com/articles/news/2017/ 2018年11月15日閲覧. ^ a b c d e f g h i j k h i b "".

meaning: （意味を準備中）
)に苦しめられること(身体の断絶のように見えること).

definitions.definitionEn: To be afflicted by (a visible disruption of the body)

example.en: He's come out in spots.
example.ja: 彼はスポットに出てくる。

meaning: 問題や困難に直面した時、解決し、解決する、あるいは自然に理解できるようになることです

definitions.definitionEn: Of problems or difficulties, to work out, resolve, or become understood eventually and naturally.

example.en: It may look like a huge mess now, but I expect that it will all come out in the wash as time goes on.
example.ja: 今では大混乱のように思えるかもしれませんが、時がたつにつれて、すべてが洗い流されることを期待しています。

meaning: 社会的活動や狂信的になるため

definitions.definitionEn: To become more socially active or gregarious.

meaning: 攻撃的で、敵対的であり、挑発的な態度を取ることによって、出会いや交流を始める

definitions.definitionEn: To initiate an encounter or interaction by behaving in an unrestrainedly aggressive, confrontational, or accusatory manner.

example.en: {{quote-journal|en|date=1 Feb 1972|title=Kuhn Blasts Rozelle's Poll|titleurl=http://news.google.com/newspapers?id=2_sjAAAAIBAJ&sjid=d2YEAAAAIBAJ&pg=6010,134971&dq=coming-out-swinging&hl=en|journal=Sarasota Herald-Tribune|page=C1

definitions.definitionEn: To display spunk and strength of character, especially when rising above or when fighting back against trouble or adversity.

example.en: {{RQ:en:New York Times|date=26 Feb 1967|author=Paul H. Dougherty|title=Advertising: Oldest Agency Thinking Young|url=http://select.nytimes.com/gst/abstract.html?res=FA0F16FA3A5F137A93C4AB1789D85F438685F9|page=F16

meaning: 予期せぬ事を言って

definitions.definitionEn: To say something unexpected.

example.en: He came out with a very dubious excuse.
example.ja: 彼は非常に怪しげな口実を持って出て来た。

definitions.definitionEn: To make something public or available to the public.

example.en: We're coming out with the new product on Tuesday.
example.ja: 火曜日に新製品を発表します
